_comment: The budgets skills/audit/scripts/fleet_check.py reports against. testSeconds is the wall time of every tests/test_*.py module run in parallel. docWords counts tracked markdown outside skills/, and skillWords counts tracked markdown under skills/. Raise a number only with the story that needs the room. The testCount of 569 is the measured count after the stories that followed the raise-cap, run-tests snapshot and isolation work (#81, #115, #110, #112) added a test for each gate they shipped, plus the two that guard this budget check (#172). Trimming tests would remove that coverage, so the count is raised and the word budgets are held by trimming.
